p: thirsteth for thee: Though he was both hungry and in great distress, yet he made God above all meat and drink.
I have seen thee in the: In this misery I exercise myself in the contemplation of your power and glory, as if I were in the sanctuary.
marrow and fatness: The remembrance of your favour is more sweet to me than all the pleasures and dainties of the world.
followeth hard after thee: He assures himself by the Spirit of God to have the gift of constancy.
They shall fall by the sword: He prophecies of the destruction of Saul and they who take his part, whose bodies will not be buried but be devoured with wild beasts.
sweareth by him shall glory: All who swear by God correctly or profess him will rejoice in this worthy king.
